title: 第15课 · 新年就要到了
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 15 — 新年就要到了 · The New Year is coming

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在朋友家 — At a friend's home

items.zh: A：今天是12月20日，新年就要到了。
items.py: A: Jīntiān shì shí'èr yuè èrshí rì, xīnnián jiù yào dào le.
items.en: A: Today is 20 December. The New Year is almost here.

items.py: B: Xīnnián nǐ zhǔnbèi zuò shénme?
items.en: B: What are you planning for New Year?

items.zh: A：我想去北京旅游，北京很不错，我去过一次。
items.py: A: Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚyóu, Běijīng hěn búcuò, wǒ qùguo yí cì.
items.en: A: I want to visit Beijing — it's great, I've been once.

items.py: B: Nǐ mǎi piào le ma?
items.en: B: Have you bought a ticket?

items.zh: A：还没有呢，明天就去火车站买票。
items.py: A: Hái méiyǒu ne, míngtiān jiù qù huǒchēzhàn mǎi piào.
items.en: A: Not yet. I'll go to the station tomorrow to buy one.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在公司 — In the company

items.zh: A：时间过得真快，新的一年快要到了！
items.py: A: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, xīn de yì nián kuàiyào dào le!
items.en: A: Time flies — the new year is almost here!

items.zh: B：是啊，谢谢大家这一年对我的帮助！
items.py: B: Shì a, xièxie dàjiā zhè yì nián duì wǒ de bāngzhù!
items.en: B: Yes. Thank you all for your help this year!

items.zh: C：希望我们的公司明年更好！
items.py: C: Xīwàng wǒmen de gōngsī míngnián gèng hǎo!
items.en: C: Here's to an even better year for our company!

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在车站 — At the station

items.zh: A：你妹妹怎么还没来？都八点四十了！
items.py: A: Nǐ mèimei zěnme hái méi lái? Dōu bā diǎn sìshí le!
items.en: A: Why isn't your younger sister here yet? It's already 8:40!

items.py: B: Wǒmen zài děng tā jǐ fēnzhōng ba.
items.en: B: Let's wait a few more minutes.

items.py: A: Dōu děng tā bàn ge xiǎoshí le!
items.en: A: We've already waited half an hour!

items.zh: B：她来了，我听见她说话了。
items.py: B: Tā lái le, wǒ tīngjiàn tā shuō huà le.
items.en: B: Here she is — I can hear her voice.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在咖啡馆门口 — Outside a coffee house

items.py: A: Tiān yīn le, wǒ yào huíqu le.
items.en: A: It's clouding over, I'm going home.

items.zh: B：好的。快要下雨了，你路上慢点儿。
items.py: B: Hǎo de. Kuàiyào xià yǔ le, nǐ lùshang màn diǎnr.
items.en: B: OK. It's about to rain — take care on the way.

items.py: A: Méi guānxi, wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē.
items.en: A: Don't worry, I'll take the bus.

items.py: B: Hǎo de. Zàijiàn.
items.en: B: OK. Bye.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (快要 / 快 / 就要 / 要……了: about to)

items.py: Huǒchē kuàiyào lái le.
items.en: The train is about to arrive.

items.py: Yào xià yǔ le.
items.en: It's going to rain.

items.py: Xīn de yì nián kuàiyào dào le.
items.en: The new year is almost here.

items.zh: 下个月我们就要回国了。
items.py: Xià ge yuè wǒmen jiù yào huí guó le.
items.en: We're going home next month (with a time word: only 就要).

items.py: Míngtiān jiějie jiù yào zǒu le.
items.en: My sister is leaving tomorrow.

items.zh: 下个星期我们就要考试了。
items.py: Xià ge xīngqī wǒmen jiù yào kǎoshì le.
items.en: We have exams next week.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (都……了: already, complaining)

items.py: Dōu bā diǎn le, kuài diǎnr qǐ chuáng ba.
items.en: It's already eight — get up!

items.zh: 你都十岁了，可以自己洗衣服了。
items.py: Nǐ dōu shí suì le, kěyǐ zìjǐ xǐ yīfu le.
items.en: You're ten already — you can wash your own clothes.

items.py: Dōu děng tā bàn ge xiǎoshí le.
items.en: We've been waiting for her for half an hour already.

items.zh: 新年的时候他准备做什么？
items.py: Xīnnián de shíhou tā zhǔnbèi zuò shénme?
items.en: What is he planning for New Year?

items.py: Míngtiān tā yǒu shénme shì yào zuò?
items.en: What does he have to do tomorrow?

items.py: Tāmen liǎng ge rén zài děng shéi ne?
items.en: Who are the two of them waiting for?

items.py: Tāmen děng de rén láile méiyǒu?
items.en: Has the person they're waiting for arrived?

items.py: Wàimiàn de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
items.en: What's the weather like outside?
